description.value: A fee-based Mosaic Forest Management recreation campsite on central Vancouver Island near Nanaimo, likely reached via managed forest roads; the sparse page content confirms little beyond the booking requirement.

address.value: 4 F Br Rd, Nanaimo Lakes, BC V9R 1L5, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms the campsite is real, operational, and accepting reservations for the 2026 season (April 1–October 13) on Mosaic Forest Management land near Nanaimo Lake. Site descriptions confirm tents are permitted and an online booking system is present, supporting reservations=true. No amenity details (water, toilets, showers, etc.) are described in the fetched content, so those fields remain null.
concerns: No phone number or physical address available in OSM or on the website.
Website is ~35 minutes by car from all services in Nanaimo; cyclists should be aware the approach via forest service road may be challenging and resupply is not available nearby.
Several facility amenity subpages (campsite rules, FAQ, contact) returned only a loading spinner ('Give us a moment...') with no substantive content, leaving most amenity fields unverifiable.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operational campsite with active online bookings for the 2026 season; directly relevant to touring cyclists seeking overnight accommodation near Nanaimo.
enrichment_extras.notes: Firewood may be available on-site; website advises checking with the host. Off-season whole-campground rentals are also available via campsites@silvifor.com.
